'''Rej Taunt''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Askajian/Legends|Askajian]] crime boss who lived on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]. As the eldest son of a family of [[Tomuon]] cloth traders, he was inherently wealthy. Rej was a previous owner of the rebuilt [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighter]] that came to be known as the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']]; under his command, the YT-1300 was known as the ''Second Chance''.

While Taunt was on a job from a [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] [[Vigo/Legends|Vigo]] to pick up an order of [[Pistoeka sabotage droid/Legends|buzz droids]], the unsecured droids managed to activate and start dismantling the ''Second Chance'' from the inside out. The buzz droids were successfully jettisoned from the ship. However, an [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship/Legends|''Acclamator''-class assault ship]] accompanied by a [[Destroyer/Legends|Destroyer]] approached the YT-1300 to do a search. The Imperial Acclamator flew through the swarm of buzz droids, which then dismantled the ship.

A little more than 60 years later, Rej was visited by [[Tobb Jadak]] and [[Flitcher Poste]] while incarcerated on [[Carcel]].
